follow-up time: Through pregnancy and the puerperal period
cohort: 28 pregnancies in 22 women diagnosed with MMD
finding: Careful management of blood pressure, hyperventilation, and consideration of delivery and anesthesia methods are important for pregnant women with MMD to avoid unfavorable sequelae.
mod_finding: The majority of pregnancies (92.5%) in women with MMD resulted in cesarean section, with 76% performed under regional anesthesia and 24% under general anesthesia.
